name: Tom's Thumb Trailhead main lot, end of 128th Street (north side of range)
basis: Mountain Project McDowell Mountains 'Getting There': area is accessed via the Tom's Thumb Trailhead on the north side of the range, reached by driving south on 128th Street to the trailhead entrance; Gateway Visitor Center approach (~6 mi uphill) explicitly NOT recommended. Sven Slab page: start at the easternmost (main) Tom's Thumb lot. Mapped lot chosen by position as the easternmost non-trailer lot in the cluster at the 128th St trailhead (33.695N); five sibling polygons nearby are overflow/trailer.
